title: Unauthorized observer is denied before repository discovery
owner: Forge Product, Experience, and Quality Architecture
preconditions: The synthetic identity is authenticated but has no membership in fixture-workspace
The named repository may or may not exist; the response cannot reveal that fact
The Developer Trial profile is active

steps.action: Run forge delivery start --workspace fixture-workspace --project forge --repository forge --intent-file <fixture-intent> --output json
steps.checkpoint: The public CLI returns the normalized forbidden error without resource-existence detail

steps.action: Inspect disclosure-safe evidence through the public CLI projection
steps.checkpoint: The denial is recorded and no repository, context, worker, or publication side effect exists

expectedOutcomes.assertion: The request returns stable code forbidden before repository discovery
The response and evidence do not reveal whether the workspace, project, or repository exists
No delivery run, context package, worker task, branch, or pull request is created
The seeded sensitive value is absent from CLI output, telemetry, and routine evidence

forbiddenOutcomes: The request is permitted or treated as indeterminate success
Workspace, project, or repository existence is disclosed
Repository discovery or context retrieval occurs
A delivery run, worker, branch, or pull request is created
The seeded sensitive value appears in output or evidence
The scenario or candidate changes its expected outcomes

releaseConditions: The denial oracle passes three consecutive clean runs
Security and Quality owners remove quarantine
